# ArchitectUI — full reference for agents

> A ready-made Bootstrap 5.3 admin theme: `architectui.css` + `architectui.js` on top of CDN Bootstrap and Lucide. Write standard Bootstrap 5 markup, add `aui-` classes for the theme extras, and every page gets the same finished look, dark mode and switchable themes. MIT license.

This file is the complete usage reference. The short index is `llms.txt`. Work in the repository itself is described in `AGENTS.md`.

## 1. What it is and when to use it

ArchitectUI is a theme, not a component framework. It styles the HTML that Bootstrap 5 already defines and adds a page frame (header, sidebar, page title, footer) plus a few dashboard pieces (number widgets, card actions, animated tabs).

Use it when you need:

- an admin panel, dashboard or back office that looks finished without design work;
- plain HTML, server-rendered templates (PHP, Python, Ruby, Go, Node) or static pages;
- a consistent look across many pages and people, with themes and dark mode for free;
- no build pipeline on the consumer side.

It is a poor fit when you need a marketing site with a unique visual identity, or a fully custom design system built from scratch.

### Compared with Tailwind CSS and other utility-first kits

| Topic | ArchitectUI | Tailwind-style utility CSS |
|-------|-------------|---------------------------|
| Starting point | Finished components: cards, buttons, tables, forms, navs, modals, toasts | Low-level utilities; each component is designed by you |
| Consistency | Built in: one class (`btn btn-primary`) gives the same result on every page | Depends on discipline; long class lists drift apart |
| Build step | None: link CDN files and the theme | Required to generate CSS |
| Theme switch | One attribute plus one stylesheet; every page changes together | Markup changes in many places |
| Dark mode | Every component and every theme has it | Each component needs `dark:` variants |
| Behavior | Sidebar collapse, icon rail, off-canvas menu, search, settings panel, theme switching, Bootstrap JS components | Not included |
| Markup | Standard, documented Bootstrap 5 | Project-specific class combinations |

Do not add Tailwind, Bulma, Foundation or another CSS framework to ArchitectUI pages. They fight over base styles and break the consistent look.

### Compared with plain Bootstrap 5

Same markup and JavaScript API. ArchitectUI adds the admin frame, a designed default look (Business), nine more themes, extra colors (`focus`, `alternate`, `tertiary`), dashboard widgets, Lucide icon rendering and persistent layout settings. Anything that works in Bootstrap 5.3 works inside the theme.

## 2. Files and dependencies

Release files in `dist/`:

- `architectui.css` — the theme: layout, components, tokens, the default Business look.
- `architectui.js` — the theme behavior. Classic script, no dependencies, about 150 lines.
- `themes/<id>.css` — optional visual themes, loaded after `architectui.css`.
- `assets/images/` — logos, avatars, theme background image.
- `*.html` — 26 demo pages; `*.js` next to them — scripts of individual demo pages.

CDN dependencies. The exact, tested URLs are in `src/_data/cdn.json` and in the `<head>` of `dist/index.html`:

- Bootstrap 5.3: `bootstrap.min.css` and `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`
- Lucide: the UMD bundle `lucide.min.js`, global `lucide`
- Optional, per page: Chart.js 4 (`chart.umd.min.js`, global `Chart`), Leaflet 1.9 (`leaflet.js` + `leaflet.css`, global `L`), FullCalendar 6 (`index.global.min.js`, global `FullCalendar`).

All paths are relative and all scripts are classic `defer` scripts. The demo works from any folder of a web server and from disk (`file://`). To work offline, copy the CDN files to a local folder and change the URLs; the markup does not change.

## 3. Minimal page

The CDN URLs below follow the latest release of each major version; for pinned versions use the ones from `src/_data/cdn.json`. Load order matters: Bootstrap CSS, page library CSS, `architectui.css`, the inline settings script, then deferred scripts in this order: Bootstrap bundle, Lucide, page libraries, `architectui.js`, the page script.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-aui-header="fixed" data-aui-sidebar="fixed" data-aui-footer="static" data-aui-tabs="shadow" data-aui-dark-only="cyberpunk">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Page title</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" crossorigin="anonymous">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="architectui.css">
  <script>
  // Applies saved settings before the first paint (attributes, theme stylesheet, light/dark mode)
  (function () {
    var d = document.documentElement, s = {}, m, t;
    try { s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("architectui")) || {}; } catch (e) {}
    for (var k in s) d.setAttribute("data-aui-" + k, s[k]);
    t = /^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(s.theme || "") ? s.theme : "";
    m = s.mode || "light";
    if (t) {
      var css = document.querySelector('link[href$="architectui.css"]').getAttribute("href");
      document.write('<link rel="stylesheet" id="aui-theme" href="' + css.replace(/architectui\.css$/, "themes/" + t + ".css") + '">');
      if ((" " + d.getAttribute("data-aui-dark-only") + " ").indexOf(" " + t + " ") > -1) m = "dark";
    }
    if (m === "system") m = matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";
    d.setAttribute("data-bs-theme", m);
  })();
  </script>
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@1/dist/umd/lucide.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
  <script defer src="architectui.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="aui-app">
    <header class="aui-header">...</header>
    <aside class="aui-sidebar">...</aside>
    <main class="aui-main" id="main">
      <div class="aui-main__inner">
        <div class="aui-page-title">...</div>
        <!-- page content: Bootstrap rows, cards, forms, tables -->
      </div>
      <footer class="aui-footer">...</footer>
    </main>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

The fastest correct start is to copy `dist/index.html` and replace the content inside `.aui-main__inner` after the page title. The inline script is optional when you do not use the settings panel or a stored theme; without it the page uses the attributes written in the HTML.

## 4. Page frame

### Structure

```text
body
├── svg (gradient definitions for aui-icon-gradient-*; optional)
├── .aui-app
│   ├── header.aui-header
│   │   ├── .aui-header__brand: mobile burger, .aui-logo, collapse burger, "more" button (phones)
│   │   └── .aui-header__content.collapse#auiHeaderContent
│   │       ├── .aui-header__left: .aui-search, ul.nav.aui-header-menu
│   │       └── .aui-header__right: .aui-mode-toggle, .aui-user
│   ├── aside.aui-sidebar
│   │   └── .offcanvas-md.offcanvas-start.aui-sidebar__panel#auiSidebar
│   │       └── .offcanvas-body > ul.aui-nav#auiNav
│   └── main.aui-main#main
│       ├── .aui-main__inner
│       │   ├── .aui-page-title
│       │   └── page content
│       └── footer.aui-footer
├── .offcanvas.aui-settings#auiSettings (settings panel; optional)
└── .toast-container (optional)
```

### Responsive behavior

- 1250 px and wider: full sidebar; the collapse burger (`data-aui-toggle="sidebar"`) collapses it to an icon rail.
- 768–1249 px: icon rail; it expands over the content on hover.
- Below 768 px: the sidebar is a Bootstrap Offcanvas opened by the mobile burger; header items fold into `#auiHeaderContent`.

### Sidebar menu

```html
<ul class="aui-nav" id="auiNav">
  <li class="aui-nav__heading">Dashboards</li>
  <li><a class="aui-nav__link active" href="index.html" aria-current="page"><i data-lucide="rocket" class="aui-nav__icon"></i>Analytics</a></li>
  <li>
    <a class="aui-nav__link collapsed" href="#nav-elements" role="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav-elements">
      <i data-lucide="gem" class="aui-nav__icon"></i>Elements<i data-lucide="chevron-down" class="aui-nav__caret"></i>
    </a>
    <div class="collapse" id="nav-elements" data-bs-parent="#auiNav">
      <ul class="aui-nav__sub">
        <li><a class="aui-nav__link" href="elements-buttons-standard.html">Buttons</a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </li>
</ul>
```

Icons are 20 px (`--aui-nav-icon-size`) and centered in the row. Mark the current page with `active` and `aria-current="page"`; open its group with `show` on the `.collapse` and `aria-expanded="true"` on the toggle.

### Page title

```html
<div class="aui-page-title">
  <div class="aui-page-title__wrapper">
    <div class="aui-page-title__heading">
      <div class="aui-page-title__icon"><i data-lucide="archive" class="aui-icon-gradient-primary"></i></div>
      <div>
        Page name
        <div class="aui-page-title__subheading">One sentence about the page.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="aui-page-title__actions"><!-- buttons, dropdowns --></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Section tabs under the title

```html
<ul class="aui-body-tabs aui-tabs-animated nav">
  <li class="nav-item"><a role="tab" class="nav-link active" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#tab-1"><span>Overview</span></a></li>
  <li class="nav-item"><a role="tab" class="nav-link" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#tab-2"><span>Details</span></a></li>
</ul>
<div class="tab-content">
  <div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="tab-1" role="tabpanel">...</div>
  <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-2" role="tabpanel">...</div>
</div>
```

Always give the first tab `active`. The style (`shadow` or `line`) comes from `data-aui-tabs` on `<html>`.

### Logo

Replace the files, nothing else: `assets/images/logo.png` for light backgrounds and `assets/images/logo-on-dark.png` for dark backgrounds. Wide and square logos both fit into `--aui-logo-max-height` (2.25rem).

## 5. Settings, attributes and JavaScript API

### Attributes on `<html>`

| Attribute | Values | Default |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| `data-aui-header` | `fixed`, `static` | `fixed` |
| `data-aui-sidebar` | `fixed`, `static` | `fixed` |
| `data-aui-footer` | `fixed`, `static` | `static` |
| `data-aui-sidebar-collapsed` | present or absent | absent |
| `data-aui-tabs` | `shadow`, `line` | `shadow` |
| `data-aui-header-scheme`, `data-aui-sidebar-scheme` | `primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `light`, `dark`, `focus`, `alternate` | none |
| `data-aui-mode` | `light`, `dark`, `system` | `light` |
| `data-aui-theme` | theme id (see section 6); absent means Business | absent |
| `data-aui-dark-only` | space-separated ids of dark-only themes | `cyberpunk` |
| `data-bs-theme` | `light`, `dark`; set by the theme script from the mode | `light` |

### Storage

The settings are one JSON object in `localStorage` under the key `architectui`, for example `{"theme":"coffee","mode":"dark","sidebar-collapsed":"true"}`. Keys match the attribute names without `data-aui-`. Default values are not stored.

### Declarative controls (handled by `architectui.js`)

- `data-aui-setting="<key>"` on a radio or checkbox: sets the attribute and stores it. Checkboxes use `value` when checked and `data-aui-off` when not.
- `data-aui-toggle="sidebar"`: collapses or expands the sidebar (sets `aria-pressed`).
- `data-aui-toggle="mode"`: switches light and dark.
- `data-aui-reset`: restores all defaults and clears storage.
- `data-aui-search`, `data-aui-search-toggle`, `data-aui-search-close`: the header search box; Escape closes it.
- `data-aui-toast="#id"`: shows that Bootstrap toast.

The settings panel (`#auiSettings`, cog button) is built from these controls. Copy it from `dist/index.html` or leave it out.

### Script API

- `window.ArchitectUI.refresh(scope = document)`: renders Lucide icons and initialises Bootstrap tooltips and popovers inside `scope`. Call it after you insert markup with icons, tooltips or popovers.
- Event `aui:theme-change` on `document`, `event.detail.theme` = the theme id. It fires after a theme or mode change. Re-read CSS variables there (charts do this).
- `ArchitectUI` is the only global the script adds. Bootstrap adds `bootstrap`, Lucide adds `lucide`.
- `architectui.js` also works with `type="module"`, but keep it a classic `defer` script so pages open from disk.

## 6. Themes and modes

| Id | Name | Character |
|----|------|-----------|
| none | Business (default) | Built into `architectui.css`. Dense, smaller type, lines instead of shadows |
| `orange` | Orange | The original ArchitectUI look: orange accents, color gradients, soft shadows |
| `indigo` | Indigo | Neutral business palette |
| `indigo-img` | Indigo Photo | Indigo with a subtle photo behind the content |
| `coffee` | Coffee | Warm browns on neutral surfaces |
| `green` | Garden | Calm green, serif headings, airy rows |
| `raspberry` | Warm | Berry accent, pill buttons, rounder corners |
| `teal` | Operations | Zebra tables, monospace numbers |
| `violet` | Space | Large radii, soft violet shadows, heavy headings |
| `cyberpunk` | Cyberpunk | Neon on black, monospace; dark only |

How it works:

- Business rules live in `architectui.css` and apply only while `<html>` has no `data-aui-theme`.
- Any other theme is one stylesheet in `themes/`. Selecting it sets `data-aui-theme="<id>"` (this switches the Business rules off) and adds `<link id="aui-theme" href="themes/<id>.css">` after `architectui.css`. The switch at runtime loads the new link before it removes the old one, so there is no flash.
- Modes: `light`, `dark`, `system`. The mode becomes `data-bs-theme` on `<html>`, so Bootstrap's own dark mode and all theme tokens follow it.

A fixed theme without the settings panel:

```html
<html data-aui-theme="coffee">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="architectui.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="themes/coffee.css">
```

A new theme is one Sass file in `src/scss/themes/` that includes the shared base and passes a palette for both modes:

```scss
@use "theme" as t;

@include t.base;
@include t.palette(
  (bg: #f8fafc, surface: #fff, surface-2: #f1f5f9, surface-muted: #f8fafc, border: #e2e8f0,
   text: #0f172a, text-muted: #475569, text-faint: #617087, text-dim: #778aa5, danger: #e11d48,
   brand-solid: #4f46e5, brand-solid-hover: #6366f1, brand-soft: #eef2ff, brand-veil: rgba(238, 242, 255, .45),
   brand-text: #4f46e5, brand-text-hover: #6366f1, brand-ink: #4338ca, brand-faint: #626ff6,
   brand-line: #4f46e5, brand-line-soft: #c7d2fe, brand-focus: #4f46e5, brand-shadow: rgba(199, 210, 254, .7),
   shadow: "0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, .05)"),
  (/* the same keys for dark mode */)
);
```

Optional palette keys: `fill` (defaults to `surface-2`) and `accent-solid`, `accent-soft`, `accent-text`, `accent-ink`, `accent-line` (default to the brand values). Add the theme to `src/_data/themes.json` to list it in the settings panel.

## 7. Tokens (CSS variables)

Override tokens after `architectui.css` (or after the theme stylesheet). No rebuild is needed.

Layout, shared by all themes:

- `--aui-header-height` (60px), `--aui-sidebar-width` (280px), `--aui-sidebar-collapsed-width` (80px)
- `--aui-logo-max-height` (2.25rem), `--aui-nav-icon-size` (20px), `--aui-gutter` (1.5rem), `--aui-transition`

Theme palette (set per mode by every theme and by Business):

- Surfaces: `--aui-app-bg`, `--aui-surface`, `--aui-surface-2`, `--aui-surface-muted`, `--aui-fill`, `--aui-border`
- Text: `--aui-text`, `--aui-text-muted`, `--aui-text-faint`, `--aui-text-dim`
- Brand and accent: `--aui-brand-solid`, `--aui-brand-soft`, `--aui-brand-text`, `--aui-brand-ink`, `--aui-brand-line`, `--aui-accent-solid` and related keys
- Rhythm: `--aui-root-size`, `--aui-font`, `--aui-heading-font`, `--aui-radius-lg`, `--aui-radius`, `--aui-radius-sm`, `--aui-shadow-sm`, `--aui-shadow-md`, `--aui-shadow-xl`, `--aui-card-padding`, `--aui-cell-py`, `--aui-th-size`
- Gradients: `--aui-gradient-<color>` and `--aui-gradient-<color>-subtle`

Bootstrap tokens (`--bs-primary`, `--bs-primary-rgb`, `--bs-body-bg` and so on) are set from the palette. To recolor one color, set both the color and its `-rgb` triplet:

```css
:root { --bs-primary: #3f6ad8; --bs-primary-rgb: 63, 106, 216; }
```

Colors: Bootstrap's `primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `light`, `dark` plus `focus`, `alternate`, `tertiary`. Every color has `btn-*`, `btn-outline-*`, `bg-*`, `text-*`, `border-*`, `text-bg-*`. `bg-<color>` paints the theme gradient for the Bootstrap colors and a solid fill for `focus`, `alternate`, `tertiary`; `text-bg-<color>` is a solid fill with the theme's contrast text color.

## 8. Component reference

Use Bootstrap 5.3 components as documented by Bootstrap. The theme already styles them. The `aui-` classes below add what Bootstrap does not have.

### Number widget

```html
<div class="card mb-3 aui-widget">
  <div class="aui-widget__wrapper">
    <div class="aui-widget__left">
      <div class="aui-widget__heading">Total Orders</div>
      <div class="aui-widget__subheading">Last year expenses</div>
    </div>
    <div class="aui-widget__right">
      <div class="aui-widget__numbers text-success"><span>1896</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

Filled variant: add `bg-primary` (or another color) to the card and `text-white` to `.aui-widget__wrapper`. Choose a dark color (`bg-primary`, `bg-success`, `bg-danger`, `bg-dark`) for white text; `-subtle` gradients are light. Add `.aui-widget__outer` around the wrapper and `.aui-widget__progress` with a Bootstrap `.progress` and `.aui-widget__progress-label` for a progress row.

### Card header with icon and actions

```html
<div class="card mb-3">
  <div class="card-header">
    <i data-lucide="laptop" class="aui-card-icon"></i>Header Menu
    <div class="ms-auto text-nowrap aui-card-actions">
      <button class="aui-btn-icon aui-btn-icon-only btn btn-link" aria-label="Download"><i data-lucide="download"></i></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="card-body">...</div>
</div>
```

The card header has a fixed height; tabs inside it stay on one line. Header tabs: put `ul.nav` directly in `.card-header` (add `aui-card-tabs-animated` for the moving bar) or a `.btn-group.nav` / `.nav` of buttons in a `.ms-auto` wrapper.

### Other theme classes

- Cards: `aui-card-border` (a real border instead of the shadow; pair with `border border-<color>`), `aui-card-shadow-<color>` (colored shadow), `aui-card-header-title`.
- Buttons: `aui-btn-shadow`, `aui-btn-wide`, `aui-btn-icon` (aligns an icon and the text with a gap), `aui-btn-icon-only`, `aui-btn-transition` (gray at rest, color on hover).
- Button groups as tabs: `.btn-group.nav` with `rounded-start-pill` on the first and `rounded-end-pill` on the last button for a capsule.
- Navs: `aui-tabs-shadow`, `aui-tabs-animated` (tabs with a moving bar), `aui-nav-icon` (icon in a nav link), `aui-nav-header`, `aui-nav-divider`, `aui-nav-btn`.
- Dropdowns: `aui-dropdown-shadow`, `aui-dropdown-hover-link`, `aui-dropdown-icon`.
- Lists: `aui-list-borderless`.
- Scroll areas: `aui-scroll` with a height class `aui-scroll-xs`, `-sm`, `-md`, `-lg`; `aui-scrollbar` for thin native scrollbars.
- Charts and maps: `aui-chart` (`aui-chart-sm`, `aui-chart-lg`) sets the chart height; `aui-map` (`aui-map-lg`) for Leaflet maps.
- Helpers: `aui-divider`, `aui-code`, `aui-fs-1` … `aui-fs-4`, `aui-fs-lg`, `aui-opacity-60` … `aui-opacity-90`, `aui-flex-2`.
- Animations: `aui-animate-fade-in`, `aui-animate-flip`, `aui-animate-light-speed-in`, `aui-animate-pulse`, `aui-animate-spin`.
- Icon color: `aui-icon-gradient-<color>` strokes a Lucide icon with a theme gradient (needs the SVG gradient definitions from `partials/icon-gradients.njk` in the page).

### Toasts

Filled toasts use `text-bg-<color>`; the header and the close button follow the text color:

```html
<div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3">
  <div class="toast text-bg-success" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
    <div class="toast-header">
      <i data-lucide="circle-check" class="me-2"></i><strong class="me-auto">Saved</strong>
      <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="toast" aria-label="Close"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="toast-body">The changes are stored.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Forms

Use Bootstrap 5 form markup. A check or radio is an `input.form-check-input` followed by `label.form-check-label` with `for`; never put the input inside the label. Validation uses Bootstrap's `needs-validation` and `was-validated`.

### Icons

Lucide icons: `<i data-lucide="name"></i>`. The full list with search is on the Icons demo page (`dist/elements-icons.html`) and at https://lucide.dev/icons. Icons take the text color and scale with the font size. After inserting markup with icons, call `ArchitectUI.refresh(container)`.

## 9. Third-party libraries on a page

- Chart.js: load the UMD bundle before the page script. Read colors from CSS variables (`getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--bs-primary")`) and re-render on `aui:theme-change`. Put the canvas in `.aui-chart`.
- FullCalendar: load the global bundle; it follows the theme without extra styles.
- Leaflet: load `leaflet.css` and `leaflet.js`; put the map in `.aui-map`.
- Wrap page scripts in an IIFE and read libraries from `window` so nothing leaks into the global scope.

## 10. Rules for agents building pages with ArchitectUI

1. Start from `dist/index.html` or a demo page close to the task. Keep the frame and change the content.
2. Use Bootstrap 5.3 markup and utilities. Add `aui-` classes only from section 8. Do not invent new `aui-` classes in pages; put new styles in your own stylesheet after `architectui.css`.
3. Style through tokens. Use `var(--aui-*)` and `var(--bs-*)` in custom CSS instead of fixed hex colors, so themes and dark mode keep working.
4. Do not add Tailwind, jQuery, Font Awesome or another CSS framework.
5. Keep relative paths and classic `defer` scripts. Do not use import maps or root-absolute URLs.
6. Give every tab list an `active` first tab, every modal trigger a `data-bs-target="#id"` that exists, and every form check a label with `for`.
7. After dynamic inserts call `ArchitectUI.refresh(element)`.
8. Check the page in light and dark mode and at least in Business and Orange.
